summary: Recruitment-process page (14 blocks, 7,600 px) in the TOA style: photo head, a five-point teal strip, a video band, four service tiles, a dark purple six-item feature block, founder message, team videos, client quotes, resources and a closing strip. Needs five commitments, four role types, six features and videos.

sections.note: very light office photo, left serif title and two short paragraphs
pale teal strip: heading and five columns each with a bold title and two lines; one pill button
heading and a line, then one large black video slot on a blurred photo ground with a coral button
centered heading and line; four columns each a purple title, a short paragraph and an Explore link
deep purple band: heading and six items in two columns each with a white icon, a title, a paragraph and a >>More link; a coral button below
meet some of the team: two black video slots with name captions
teal band with a video quote slot and button
industry insights: four small cards; then a download-guide band and a teal closing strip with a button
